name: Second Harvest
description: Second Harvest provides free groceries and fresh meals to families, seniors and individuals facing food insecurity.

name: Rocket Dog Rescue
description: Rocket Dog Rescue saves abandoned dogs from overcrowded shelters and places them in loving, permanent homes.

name: Birthfund
description: Birthfund provides grants for midwifery care, lactation support and postpartum resources to families facing hardship.

name: Sunday Friends
description: Sunday Friends helps low-income families break the cycle of poverty with education, financial literacy and basic necessities.

name: Sierra Club
description: The Sierra Club protects wild places and fights for clean air, clean water and solutions to the climate crisis.
